jobs.name: a1-reframe-ref
jobs.prompt:
Direct-response Meta feed ad (portrait) for a LIVE PTE exam masterclass, designed to make study-abroad students register. You are given THREE reference images: (1) a man (the trainer); (2) the Verbis Edu logo; (3) a Google review badge.

Use the MAN exactly — same face, beard, warm confident smile, navy bandhgala jacket — cut him out from his party background and place him on the RIGHT side, cropped mid-chest up, facing the viewer. Do not change his face.

Reproduce the VERBIS EDU LOGO (reference 2) in the TOP-LEFT corner EXACTLY as provided — identical colours, tiles, mark and text; do not redraw, restyle, recolour or crop it.
Reproduce the GOOGLE REVIEW BADGE (reference 3) in the LOWER-LEFT, just below the call-to-action button, EXACTLY as provided — keep the four-colour Google 'G', the five stars, the '4.9' and '491 Google reviews' text unchanged.

Background: warm cream (#F9F7F3). Design system: deep teal (#0E4852) headline ink, gold (#FBBD29) accents, clean modern geometric sans-serif, generous whitespace, premium and trustworthy. A subtle faint gold concentric-ring motif behind the man.

LEFT column, stacked top to bottom (below the logo):
- a small gold pill badge with deep-teal text: 'LIVE · 4-HOUR PTE MASTERCLASS'
- a huge bold headline, three lines: 'It's not your' / 'English.' / 'It's the format.' with the word 'format.' in gold
- one line of medium grey subtext: 'Why fluent speakers still score 65 — and how to fix it in 4 hours.'
- a trainer credit: deep teal 'with Parthasarathy Bhaskara', and under it smaller grey 'Pearson-certified PTE Trainer · 2,500+ students trained'
- a small strikethrough '₹2,999' then a gold rounded button with deep-teal text: 'Claim my seat  →  ₹589'
- then the Google review badge (reference 3)

BOTTOM: a slim deep-teal band spanning the width with gold text: 'Sat 11 July · 10 AM-2 PM IST · Online'.

Every piece of text must be crisp, correctly spelled and legible. Professional ad-agency quality.
